commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== create opsadmin =="
sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash opsadmin
echo "== set up .ssh =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /home/opsadmin/.ssh
sudo -n bash -c 'echo "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAINMKA2+oNHxgmpABaV61Sar8lVW2YxSL8Aw9d7b5yLh1 os-comparison@example.invalid" > /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys'
sudo -n chmod 700 /home/opsadmin/.ssh
sudo -n chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
sudo -n chown -R opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh
echo "== lock password (key-only for this user) =="
sudo -n passwd -l opsadmin
echo "== verify sshd_config has no conflicting Match block for opsadmin =="
sudo -n grep -n -A5 -i '^Match' /etc/ssh/sshd_config || echo "no Match blocks"
echo "== ensure PasswordAuthentication no and PubkeyAuthentication yes globally (already set, reaffirm) =="
sudo -n sed -i 's/^#\?PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
sudo -n sed -i 's/^#\?PubkeyAuthentication.*/PubkeyAuthentication yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
sudo -n sed -i 's/^#\?ChallengeResponseAuthentication.*/ChallengeResponseAuthentication no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
sudo -n sshd -t
echo "== restart sshd to apply =="
sudo -n systemctl restart ssh || sudo -n systemctl restart sshd
sudo -n systemctl is-active ssh sshd 2>&1 || true
echo "== final config check =="
sudo -n grep -Ei '^\s*(PasswordAuthentication|PubkeyAuthentication|ChallengeResponseAuthentication)' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
echo "== final user check =="
id opsadmin
sudo -n cat /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
sudo -n passwd -S opsadmin
